steps.text: Each player picks a Clan: Clan Screen with a Political/War tile behind it, Political side up
Sit clockwise in order of Starting Honor Rank (on the screens), lowest first
One Clan marker on the first Victory Point slot; the other on the Honor Track in Starting Honor Rank order
Daimyo (black base), 3 Shinto (white bases) and 6 Bushi in your Reserve; your Monster bases, 4 Strongholds and Alliance token beside you
Daimyo, 1 Bushi and 1 Stronghold in your Home Province
4 random Shrine tiles faceup left to right; box the other 3
steps.note: First game: Amaterasu, Fujin, Hachiman, Tsukuyomi

steps.text: Spring, Summer and Autumn decks: 7 Core cards + the 5 {set} cards each (12 per deck)
War Province tokens sorted by I, II, III into 3 facedown piles of 8
War Number tokens next to the board
Shuffle the 10 Political Mandate tiles facedown in a pile
Monster figures, Coins and Ronin within reach

details: Sacred Bounty: anything you buy (Season cards, Strongholds) costs at most 1 coin; discounts apply after
Eddies in the Stream: at the start of the War Phase, trade all your Ronin for coins
In Hire Ronin, every coin in your reserve counts as a Ronin
Dictate the Flow: play your chosen Political Mandate face down and announce any Mandate you like
Gossamer Wings: summon to any Province (Stronghold or not) and move anywhere, without Shipping Routes
Shell of the Eternal: Strongholds move like figures and count as 1 Force
Your Strongholds are never killed, taken hostage or Betrayed

steps.text: Deals are never binding; bribes only in Tea Ceremony and Political Phase
Start Spring with the Seasonal Setup: prepare for war, set Season cards, income
